stories.title: Ewloe homes fight reaches planning inspector as councillor lodges 39-page objection
stories.summary: A Hawarden community councillor has urged a planning inspector to throw out a developer’s appeal over 315 homes on farmland in Ewloe. Cllr Connor Wynne has lodged a 39-page objection with Planning and Environment Decisions Wales, the body deciding Castle Green Homes’ appeal over land between Holywell Road and Green Lane. stories.title: Holywell care home rated excellent by Care Inspectorate Wales
stories.summary: A care home near Holywell for adults with learning disabilities and autism has been rated excellent in three of four areas by Care Inspectorate Wales. stories.title: Flintshire woman jailed for eight years in Rhyl child sexual exploitation case
stories.summary: A woman from Flintshire has been jailed for eight years for perverting the course of justice and drug supply offences, following a child sexual exploitation investigation in Rhyl. stories.title: Commission proposes 3% rise in councillor pay across Wales
stories.summary: Councillors in Wales would get a 3 per cent pay rise in 2027-28, taking their basic salary to £21,676, under draft proposals published by the Democracy and Boundary Commission Cymru. stories.title: Man believed to have entered water at Flint Castle found dead at West Kirby Marine Lake
stories.summary: Detectives are appealing for anyone who was around Flint Castle on the evening of Monday 14 September, after a man was found dead at West Kirby Marine Lake two days later.
